n.story:
Your role is undergoing a profound transformation from a gatekeeper of physical assets to a navigator of digital and intellectual landscapes. The days of manual cataloging, inventory tracking, and answering repetitive reference questions are fading, as AI systems now classify materials and handle basic inquiries with near-perfect accuracy. This frees you from the 'back-room' logistics that once dominated your week.

You are becoming a high-level information consultant and digital literacy coach. As AI makes information more abundant but also more prone to misinformation, your role in assessing informational needs and interpreting complex copyright or fair-use cases becomes critical. You will spend your time helping patrons navigate the ethics of AI-generated content and curating specialized collections that require a human touch and community-specific context.
auto: Managing routine inventory and RFID tracking
Answering basic factual and directional queries
amp: Advanced synthesis of complex research queries
Expert guidance on copyright and intellectual property
Personalized digital literacy and AI ethics instruction
Curation of niche or culturally sensitive collections
Predictive analysis of community informational needs
tools: Large Language Models for reference assistance
n.adv: Shift your focus from 'how to find information' to 'how to evaluate and use information.' Become an expert in AI prompting and digital ethics to lead the literacy programs your community will desperately need.
